Used as 'we may first write $R=\colim R_\lambda$ as a directed colimit of local $\mathbf Z$-algebras which are essentially of finite type' in the proofs of Lemma Tag 00QX (line 32427) and Lemma Tag 00R7 (lemma-criterion-flatness-fibre, line 32992).

proof.text: Index by the finitely generated Z-subalgebras A of R, ordered by inclusion, using the nonempty directed system in [lemma-nagata-ring-finite-type-subalgebras]. This is the finite-subset construction of the source with generating sets forgotten. Let q_A be the comap of the maximal ideal of R along the inclusion A -> R. It is prime. Put L_A = Localization.AtPrime q_A using [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime]. Each L_A is local. Since A is finite type over Z by [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], localization stability and composition of [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra] show L_A is essentially finite type over Z.

proof.text: For A <= B the inclusion has q_A equal to the comap of q_B. Localization.localRingHom gives the transition L_A -> L_B and its IsLocalHom instance. It sends the algebraMap of a to the algebraMap of its inclusion in B. IsLocalization.ringHom_ext reduces the identity and composition laws to this formula, where they are the identity and composition laws of inclusions.

proof.text: Every denominator s outside q_A maps to a unit of R by [lem-weil-pbc-local-ring-unit-criterion]. IsLocalization.lift therefore extends the inclusion A -> R to pi_A : L_A -> R. Its formula on algebraMap elements and localization extensionality give compatibility with transition maps. To show pi_A is local, write x = a/s. If pi_A(x) is a unit, pi_A(x) times the unit image of s is the image of a, by the fraction specification. Thus a is outside the contracted maximal ideal; IsLocalization.AtPrime.isUnit_mk'_iff shows x is a unit. This proves unit reflection and hence IsLocalHom pi_A.

proof.text: For a cocone s on the localized system with arbitrary commutative ring point T, precompose each leg with A -> L_A. The transition formula gives a cocone on the finite-subalgebra diagram. The colimit [lemma-nagata-ring-finite-type-subalgebras], implemented by CommRingCat.isColimitFgSubalgebraCocone, provides its unique map d : R -> T. For each A, the maps d composed with pi_A and s_A agree on A by the original colimit factorization. Localization extensionality implies agreement on L_A. Any other map satisfying those factorizations satisfies the original finite-subalgebra factorizations and hence equals d by the original colimit uniqueness. This constructs the IsColimit witness in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] directly; injectivity of the pi_A is not needed.

lean.statement: theorem exists_local_essFiniteType_colimit (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R] : ∃ (I : Type u) (_ : Preorder I) (_ : Nonempty I) (_ : IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)) (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (π : F ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj (CommRingCat.of R)), (∀ i : I, IsLocalRing (F.obj i)) ∧ (∀ (i j : I) (f : i ⟶ j), IsLocalHom (F.map f).hom) ∧ (∀ i : I, IsLocalHom (π.app i).hom) ∧ Nonempty (IsColimit (Cocone.mk (CommRingCat.of R) π)) ∧ (∀ i : I, Algebra.EssFiniteType ℤ (F.obj i))
